name: Funding Service 4
definition: Funds related service such as a payment or a transfer related to the transaction.

Provider.name: Provider
Provider.definition: Identification of the funding service provider.

Name.name: Name
Name.definition: Name of the funding service (for example, MoneyGram, Western Union, etc.).

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Free text that can be used between the sender and the receiver to describe the details of the transfer.

ClaimCredentials.name: Claim Credentials
ClaimCredentials.definition: Code presented by the customer to claim funds.

DeferredDateTime.name: Deferred Date Time
DeferredDateTime.definition: Contains date and time value indicating scheduled deferred posting for issuer.
